formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → x1.size ≤ (124 : ℕ) → (∃ (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.gates[x4]? = Option.some x5 ∧ x5.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (x1.wires (List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (↑x6 ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (1 : ℕ), (2 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ), (18 : ℕ), (24 : ℕ), (31 : ℕ), (33 : ℕ), (37 : ℕ)]))).getD ((42 : ℕ) + x4) Bool.false = Bool.true) → ∃ (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), ¬(x1.eval (List.ofFn x5) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x6 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x6 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x7 ∧ (↑x7 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x6) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x5 x6 = Bool.true ∧ x5 x7 = Bool.true))
title: It is false that: A step toward: No circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates computes the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4
